note: Demo 01's labelling oracle: Weizenbaum's 1966 DOCTOR script, reconstructed after the widely circulated version by Charles Hayden. Keywords carry ranks; @name matches any word of a synonym group; * matches any run of words; (n) in a reassembly is the n-th decomposition part, post-substituted (my -> your); 'goto k' continues with keyword k; a decomposition marked memory stores its reassembly for later instead of replying, and memory is used when no keyword matches. Words are matched after the demo's own cleaning, so apostrophes are gone (don't is dont).
